# FlexibleAdapter build fallback

Source from [arkon/FlexibleAdapter](https://github.com/arkon/FlexibleAdapter/tree/c80135339bcff5f7f8c2c2380329dfc155b26232), exactly the commit previously requested by Houri's version catalog. Apache 2.0; see LICENSE.

JitPack reports no artifacts for this commit. The library is compiled locally with Houri's Android build tools. Its manifest package moved to Gradle's namespace and VERSION_NAME is generated explicitly for modern AGP; library behavior is unchanged.
